::: {#rem-rarity-source}
#### Source of the name

Leinster writes that, for a community whose $i$th species has relative abundance $p_i$,
"$1/p_i$ is a measure of its rarity or specialness" <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
[@leinster2021entropy, Section 2.4, p. 52].
The name "rarity" for the reciprocal of a [probability](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) is borrowed from there.

:::
